Titel: Interim SAP S/4HANA Finance Lead (Contract)
Unternehmen: Harbourline Logistics GmbH

Quelle: LinkedIn

Abgerufen am: 16.09.2026 07:30

About the job
Harbourline Logistics is moving its finance processes from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA. We are looking for an interim lead who bridges finance and IT.

Your responsibilities
Lead the finance workstream of the S/4HANA migration
Coordinate testing, cutover and hypercare with the system integrator
Align the new closing process with the group controlling team

Requirements
At least 8 years of experience in SAP S/4HANA or SAP ECC finance projects
Strong background in controlling and month-end closing
Proven track record in project management of ERP migrations
Fluent German and English

Nice to have
Experience with LucaNet or another consolidation tool
PMP or comparable certification

What we offer
Day rate: 1,150 EUR
Start: 01.11.2026, duration 9 months
Hybrid: 3 days remote per week, 2 days on site in Hamburg
